# NativePHP Charts

> Composer package (donmanueldev/nativephp-charts) that adds ten native chart types to NativePHP Mobile apps. Charts are declared in Blade or built with a fluent PHP API. iOS renders them with Swift Charts and SwiftUI Canvas; Android renders them with Jetpack Compose Canvas. There is no WebView, JavaScript chart library, or network service. It is an independent community plugin, not an official NativePHP package. MIT license.

## Requirements

- PHP ^8.4
- NativePHP Mobile ^4.0
- Android API 26 or newer
- iOS 18.2 or newer
- NativePHP Desktop and WebView rendering are not supported.

## Install

```bash
composer require donmanueldev/nativephp-charts
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=nativephp-plugins-provider --no-interaction
php artisan native:plugin:register donmanueldev/nativephp-charts --no-interaction
php artisan native:plugin:list
php artisan native:plugin:validate
```

Rebuild the iOS or Android app after installing or updating, because the renderers compile into the native shell.

## Chart elements

- `<native:line-chart>`: ordered `series` of points
- `<native:area-chart>`: ordered `series`; `area-mode` overlay or stacked
- `<native:bar-chart>`: ordered `series`; `mode` grouped or stacked, `orientation` vertical or horizontal
- `<native:scatter-chart>`: ordered `series` with numeric, date, or datetime x values
- `<native:candlestick-chart>`: zero or one series of open, high, low, close points
- `<native:pie-chart>`: ordered `segments`
- `<native:donut-chart>`: ordered `segments`; `inner-radius-ratio` 0.2 to 0.85
- `<native:radar-chart>`: `axes` (3 to 24) and `series` with one value per axis
- `<native:progress-chart>`: up to 24 `metrics` with values from 0 to 1
- `<native:contribution-heatmap>`: daily `values` keyed by ISO date

Selection callbacks bind with `_select="method"` and are decoded with `Donmanueldev\NativephpCharts\PointSelection::fromJson()`.

- [Blade and PHP equivalence](https://donmanueldev.github.io/nativephp-charts/reference/blade-php/): Blade attributes mapped to fluent PHP methods
